proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition in spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Command's Grovel option applies the Prone condition on a failed WIS save. The mastery surface already has apply_condition in SaveGateRiderResult, but spell Effect only allows damage | none. The type needs an apply_condition variant to express any condition-applying spell.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Grovel: The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn.

proposed_widenings.name: force_move in spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Approach and Flee require forcing the target to move toward or away from the caster. The v4 taxonomy has force_move but it is absent from the surface Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Approach: The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. / Flee: The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

proposed_widenings.name: restrict_turn in spell Effect (or a new restrict_action_set_on_target variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Halt suppresses the target's movement, action, and bonus action on its next turn. The existing restrict_action_set atom targets the caster's own extra-action restriction; it does not model restricting another creature's turn. A new variant or a more general on-target form of restrict_action_set is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Halt: On its turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: drop_held_items in spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Drop forces the target to release whatever it is holding. No existing v4 atom or surface Effect variant covers 'force release of held item'. This may require a new atom (drop_held_item or alter_item_kind variant).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Drop: The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

proposed_widenings.name: cast_time_command_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: Command requires the caster to choose one of five named commands at cast time before the save resolves. There is no surface-level mechanism for an ActivationPhase or Effect that branches on a caster-chosen discrete option declared at cast time. This is distinct from slot-level scaling and distinct from save branches.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You speak a one-word command... Choose the command from these options: [Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt]

notes: The spell family (activation + save_gate) fits well, and the slot-scaling multi-target upcasting fits the existing SlotScaling pattern. The blocking gap is spell Effect: it only allows damage | none, so even the narrowest encoding (Grovel alone) cannot typecheck. All five command variants require new Effect variants or subgraph support. The cast-time choice mechanic is an additional structural gap not present in any existing surface family. No dhall/json authored — the tracer would throw on the onFail effect regardless.
